firm_data.firm_description: Stockton, Barker & Mead, LLP is a full-service law firm operating in New York that was founded in 1994. The firm's priority is the client.
notable_facts: Handles thousands of cases throughout New York

email.subject: AI for Stockton, Barker & Mead, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Matthew,

With your firm handling thousands of workers' compensation and estate planning cases across New York since 1994, I imagine your team faces constant pressure to deliver BigLaw-caliber work without BigLaw resources.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing exactly that challenge. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Troy area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on document review and due diligence.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
